places.description: A Gallo-Roman settlement occupied from the late second century B.C. to the middle of the first century A.D.

places.title: Amnisos
places.description: A Bronze Age site on the north shore of Crete that may have served as a port for Knossos.

places.title: Al-Sabaa wa Arbain
places.description: Al-Sabaa wa Arbain (Saba‘ wa Arba’īn) is a small modern town in northeastern Syria (al-Hasakah Governorate). The settlement sits atop a small mound of ruins (ancient name not known).

places.title: Agora
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 54 C3 Agora

places.title: Ambracia
places.description: Ambracia (modern Arta) was an ancient city of central Greece, founded as a colony of Corinth in the seventh century BC. It was located near the Ambracian Gulf along the course of the river Arachthos.

places.title: Argos Amphilochikon
places.description: An ancient settlement in northwest Greece, mentioned in Thucydides and other ancient sources. Most scholars have long identified it with archaeological remains that lie between the modern towns of Loutro-Krikellos and Ampelaki near the Gulf of Ambrakia (but see SAGT after which BAtlas).

places.title: Kastraki of Agios Minas
places.description: An ancient fortification and associated settlement located on the Rheunikion hill, near the monastery of Euangelistrias (north of modern Aristi in Epirus).

places.title: Astakos (Acarnania)
places.description: An ancient city of Acarnania, established in the 5th century BCE, the site of Astakos lies approximately 2 kilometers north of the modern town that now bears its name. Ancient Astakos was succeeded in Byzantine times by a settlement named Dragamestos.

places.title: Corcyra (settlement)
places.description: The eponymous settlement of the island of Corcyra (modern Korfu).

places.title: Dodona (Epirus)
places.description: An ancient site of northwestern Epirus, Dodona was home to one of the most ancient oracular traditions of the Hellenic world.

places.title: Gitana
places.description: An ancient settlement of Thesprotia, which served as the seat of the Thesprotian koinon. The site is located on the west end of the large hill now known as Vrysella, just downstream from the modern dam at Fragma Kalama.

places.title: Hadrianopolis
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 54 B2 Hadrianopolis

places.title: Ithoria
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 54 D5 Ithoria

places.title: Kassope
places.description: A city with an extensive circuit wall, temple, theater, and agora.

places.title: Klimatia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 54 C2 Klimatia

places.title: Konope/Arsinoe
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 54 D4 Konope/Arsinoe

places.title: Nicopolis
places.description: An ancient city of Epirus founded by Octavian ca. 31 B.C. to commemorate his victory over Marcus Antonius and Cleopatra at the Battle of Actium.

places.title: Oiniadai
places.description: A city at the former mouth of the Achelous river.

places.title: Voulista Panagia
places.description: Described by N.G.L. Hammond writing for PECS as a fortified hill with a "circuit wall ca. 450 m long" near modern Voulista Panagia (Epirus, Greece), this site guarded a gorge leading into Central Epeiros. Hammond identified it with ancient Charadra, but Dakaris (whence BAtlas) prefers an identificat

places.title: Orraon/Horreum
places.description: Orraon was a city of the Molossians, founded probably in the early fourth century BCE and planned on a grid system. It may have been destroyed by the Romans after Pydna in 168 BCE, and its inhabitants were removed to Nikopolis in 31 BCE. The site is remarkable for the preservation of its stone-built

places.title: Paianion
places.description: An ancient settlement mentioned only by Polybius who reports its destruction and despoiling by Philip of Macedon. Its acropolis is generally agreed to be identifiable with the fortified "Palaiokastro" that lies north of the modern Greek village of Mastron, just to the west of the church of Ag. Georg

places.title: Palairos
places.description: A fortified ancient Greek city located in southern Epirus.

places.title: Paramythia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 54 C3 Paramythia

places.title: Phoinike
places.description: Phoinike was an ancient Greek city of Epirus and the location of the Treaty of Phoenice which ended the First Macedonian War.

places.title: Plakoti
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 54 B2 Plakoti

places.title: Skamneli
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 54 C2 Skamneli

places.title: Stratos
places.description: Stratos was the chief town of Acarnania. Modern Sourovigli in Greece.

places.title: Thyrreion
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 54 C4 Thyrreion

places.title: Zakythos/Zacynthus (settlement)
places.description: An ancient settlement on the Aegean island of the same name.

places.title: Angkor
places.description: The capital city of the Khmer empire, founded in the late 9th century by Yasovarman I (889-901). The city was sacked in 1431 by invaders from the Ayutthaya kingdom, and was abandoned except for the temple of Angkor Wat, which remained a Buddhist shrine.

places.title: Tell 'Ali
places.description: A small site on the left bank of the Lower Zab where an archive of ca. twenty-five Middle Assyrian texts was discovered. The town was situated more or less where travellers from Aššur to the cities Nuzi and Arrapha would have crossed the Lower Zab. Tell 'Ali is identified with ancient Atmannu.

places.title: Gaziantep
places.description: Gaziantep, also referred to as Antep, is located in southeastern Turkey. The site has a long history of settlement that begins in the Neolithic period. The site has a significant Hittite presence. Some scholars suggest it is the site of the Hellenistic city of Antiochia ad Taurum.

places.title: Gimilena
places.description: A Spanish village located in the west of Jaén that belonged to the kingdom of Alfonso X. Today it is known as Jamilena.

places.title: Amorgos (settlement)
places.description: The historic settlement of Amorgos on the Aegean island of the same name is centered around a thirteenth-century Venetian fortress.

places.title: Le Crot au Port, Fontenay-près-Vézelay
places.description: A Gallo-Roman site with a long history of occupation. There is evidence at Vézelay for the processing of iron ore, as well as a temple dedicated to Bacchus and a Gallo-Roman fanum.

places.title: Agrinion
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 A3 Agrinion

places.title: Aidepsos (spa)
places.description: A famous Euboean spa city in the Hellenistic and Roman periods, located at modern Loutra Aidepsou. The polis' original location may have been 3-4 km north in the area of a modern town that carries the modern name Aidepsos (previously Lipso).

places.title: Aigition
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 C4 Aigition

places.title: Ambrossos
places.description: An ancient Greek settlement in Phocis. Modern Distomo.

places.title: Ano Phteri
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 C3 Ano Phteri

places.title: Anthedon
places.description: A port city of northern Boeotia located in the foothills of Mount Messapion on the Gulf of Euboea.

places.title: Atrax
places.description: An ancient Greek polis in Pelasgiotis in Thessaly. The site is located in modern Greece, immediately south of the Peneios river and 2.5 km west of a small village named Κάστρο (Kastro), which is within the municipality of Larissa.

places.title: Calydon
places.description: An ancient Greek city of Aetolia that derives its name from its founder Calydon, son of Aetolus.

places.title: Chaeronea
places.description: An ancient settlement of Boeotia, Chaeronea was a subject of Orchomenus and a member of the Boeotian League. From the late fifth century BC, Chaeronea belonged to one of the 11 Boeotian districts.

places.title: Chalia
places.description: Theopompus mentions Chalia as a town of Boeotia. It is also attested epigraphically and may have been a member of the Boeotian league. Fossey locates the city in the vicinity of the church of Agios Minas in modern Drosia. Archaeological finds in the area indicate human activity from as early as the

places.title: Delion
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 F4 Delion

places.title: Delphi
places.description: The ancient panhellenic sanctuary of Delphi in Greece, seat of the oracle of Apollo.

places.title: Demetrias (Magnesian)
places.description: This ancient city, located near modern Volos in Thessaly, was founded by Demetrios Poliorketes in the third century BCE and abandoned in the 6th century CE. Continuous human activity in the area can be traced back at least as early as the Neolithic.

places.title: Drymaia
places.description: An ancient settlement. Its archaeological remains lie just to the southwest (pace NP) of modern Drymaia.

places.title: Dystos
places.description: An ancient settlement of Euboea, its acropolis subsequently became the site of a Venetian tower.

places.title: Echinos
places.description: Echinos was a town located on the northern shore of the Gulf of Malia near the modern village of Achino.

places.title: Eleutherai
places.description: A city of northern Attika at the boundary of Boeotia, Eleutherai is one of the best preserved ancient fortresses in Attica.

places.title: Erythrai
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 E4 Erythrai

places.title: Eurymenai
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 D1 Eurymenai

places.title: Gla
places.description: A large Bronze Age fortification of the Mycenaean civilization, Gla dates ca. 1300 B.C.

places.title: Gomphoi
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 B2 Gomphoi

places.title: Gonnoi
places.description: An ancient settlement of Perrhaibia, located at the western entry of the Tempe pass.

places.title: Goritsa
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 D2 Goritsa

places.title: Haliartos
places.description: Haliartos was an ancient city of Boeotia, founded as a contemporary of Orchomenos. The city was destroyed by C. Lucretius during the Third Macedonian War. There is a modern Greek town adjacent to the site, which now carries the ancient name.

places.title: Homolion
places.description: Homolion or Homolium was a polis of ancient Magnesia located in ancient Thessaly. Homolion was situated at the foot of Mount Homole near the edge of the vale of Tempe.

places.title: Hyettos
places.description: An ancient settlement of Boeotia. The site is located about 2 km east of modern Loutsi in Greece.

places.title: (Hypo)Chalkis
places.description: An ancient settlement on the Aetolian coast. The archaeological site of Chalkis is located immediately east of modern Kato Vasiliki in Western Greece.

places.title: Kallipolis
places.description: An ancient settlement in Aetolia, the remains of which are largely lost beneath the modern Mornos reservoir. The acropolis hill, now occupied by the later Velouchovo castle, can still be seen.

places.title: Kirra
places.description: An ancient port settlement located at modern Magoula Xeropigadas in the Greek municipality of Itea near where the Pleistos river debouches into the Corinthian Gulf. Classical Kirra has earlier, Helladic antecedents in this area.

places.title: Krannon/Ephyra
places.description: An ancient Thessalian settlement, with evidence of occupation in the area stretching back to the Neolithic.

places.title: Kreusis
places.description: Ancient Kreusis was the market town for Thespiae and was located on the slope of Mt. Korombili, near the modern town of Livadhostro.

places.title: Krisa
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 C4 Krisa

places.title: Kypaira
places.description: An ancient fortified settlement of Achaia Phthiotis, located between the modern Greek towns of Palaia Giannitsou, Pappas, and Perivoli in the Phthiotis Regional Unit, Thessaly. The unexcavated site lies at an altitude of 700m, comprising three hills just north of a chapel of the Agia Paraskevi.

places.title: Larisa Kremaste/Pelasgia
places.description: An ancient settlement of Achaea Phthiotis, located in the area of the modern town of Pelasgia in Greece.

places.title: Larissa
places.description: The ancient capital of the Thessalian Pelasgiotis, modern Larisa in Greece.

places.title: Leuktra
places.description: Leuktra was a settlement located in ancient Boeotia. It was located along the road leading from Thespiae to Plataea, somewhere in the vicinity of the modern town. In 371 B.C. the Thebans defeated the Spartans in a celebrated battle near the site.

places.title: Lidorikion
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 C3 Lidorikion

places.title: Lilaia
places.description: Ancient Lilaia (modern Kato Agoriani/Pyrgos in Greece) was an ancient Phocean city.

places.title: Medeon
places.description: Medeon was a polis of ancient Greece with occupation stretching from the Archaic period to Late Antiquity. It is located southeast of Aspra Spitia, Viotia, Central Greece.

places.title: Methone (Magnesian)
places.description: An ancient settlement located on the western side of the Magnesian peninsula on a hill named Nevestiki near modern Lekhonia (Volos municipality, Greece).

places.title: Metropolis (Thessaly)
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 B2 Metropolis

places.title: Narthakion
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 C3 Narthakion

places.title: Nea Pleuron
places.description: Second site of the ancient Greek city of Pleuron, built after the destruction of the original location in the 3rd century BCE. This second site boasts significant excavated remains and is located on the southern slope of Mount Aracynthus near modern Kato Retsina.

places.title: Oichalia (Aetolia)
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 B3 Oichalia

places.title: Olizon
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 E2 Olizon

places.title: Olmones
places.description: An ancient village (kome) of Boeotia, mentioned by Pausanias and Stephanus of Byzantium. It is generally identified with a paliokastro located 1km north-northeast of modern Pavlon (1.75km south-southwest of the site of Hyettos); however, the ToposText editors note a recent proposal that it be identi

places.title: Olympias/Gonnocondylus
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 C1 Olympias/Gonnocondylus

places.title: Orchomenos/Orchomenus
places.description: The so-called "Boeotian Orchomenos", located in the vicinity of the Byzantine church of Panaghia Skripou. The longer, modern title is used to distinguish this settlement from another Greek site with the same ancient name located in Arcadia in the Peloponnese.

places.title: Oreos
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 E3 Oreos

places.title: Panormos
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 F2 Panormos

places.title: Psilo Kastro (Ag. Marina)
places.description: This ancient settlement site, with remains of a fortified acropolis and lower town, is located just south of modern Ag. Marina in Thessaly (Greece). Modern scholars consider it a likely identification for ancient Patronis/Tronis/Troneia, which is mentioned in ancient sources.

places.title: Phalara
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 D3 Phalara

places.title: Pharkadon
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 C1 Pharkadon

places.title: Phayttos
places.description: An ancient settlement of Thessaly, located at modern Zarko/Zarkos in Greece.

places.title: Plataea
places.description: Plataea is an ancient city of Boeotia, located south of Thebes. In 479 BC Plataea was the site of the Battle of Plataea, in which an allied Greek army defeated the Persians. Plataea was destroyed in the Peloponnesian War by Thebes and Sparta in 427 BC and rebuilt in 386 BC.

places.title: Pteleon
places.description: An Archaic to Late Antique settlement and Mycenaean tombs on the hill Gritsa south of modern Pteleos in Magnesia Thessaly.

places.title: Pyrasos
places.description: Ancient Pyrasos in Thessaly overlooked the Bay of Volo. Its site is occupied by the modern Néa Anchiálos (Magnesia, Thessaly, Greece).

places.title: Skarpheia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 D3 Skarpheia

places.title: Skiathos (settlement)
places.description: An ancient settlement on the Sporadic island of the same name, founded in the 6th or 5th century BCE.

places.title: Stiris/Steiris
places.description: An ancient settlement of eastern Phocis. The site of ancient Steiri has only ever been partly explored and defined. The city was located in an area known locally today as Paliokhori. The acropolis has been identified on a hill locally known today as Bouli, where a church or monastery of Agios Nikola

places.title: Styra
places.description: Styra was an ancient port city located in the southwestern part of Euboea that possessed also an inland acropolis (on the modern peak of Hagios Nikolaos), extensive quarries, and a series of large stone structures known today as drakospita (dragon's houses).

places.title: Thebai/Thebae
places.description: The ancient city of Thebes in Boeotia (modern Greece).

places.title: Thermon
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 B3 Thermon

places.title: Thespiai
places.description: Thespiai was an ancient city of Boeotia, located at the foot of Mt. Helicon.

places.title: Thisbe
places.description: Thisbe was an ancient town of Boeotia located on the southern flank of Mt. Helicon.

places.title: Tol(o)phon
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 55 C4 Tol(o)phon

places.title: Xyniai
places.description: Xyniai was an ancient city located in Achaea Phthiotis in western Othrys.

places.title: Jawa (Dair El-Kahf)
places.description: A proto-urban center in Jordan's Black Desert (Dair El-Kahf subdistrict) dating from the late fourth millennium B.C. This place should not be confused with Tall Jawa in central Jordan.

places.title: Achilleion
places.description: An ancient Greek city in the southwest of the Troas. A site that in antiquity was considered to be the tomb of Achilles is nearby at Beşiktepe.

places.title: Aegae
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 E4 Aegae

places.title: Antigoneia/(Col. Augusta) Alexandria Troas
places.description: An ancient city of the Troad, founded as Antigoneia by Antigonos Monophthalmos. Lysimachos renamed the city Alexandria after 301 BCE. The city became part of the kingdom of Pergamon and, later, the Roman empire.

places.title: Antissa
places.description: An ancient settlement on a promontory on the island of Lesbos sometimes referred to as "Ovriokastro". Antissa was destroyed by Roman forces in 166 BCE. The visible archaeological remains derive mostly from a later Genoese fortress.

places.title: Asklepieion
places.description: The Asklepieion at Pergamon is located 3 km south of the Acropolis.

places.title: Assos/Apollonia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 C3 Assos/Apollonia

places.title: Attaleia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 F3 Attaleia

places.title: Augonema
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 C5 Augonema

places.title: Chios (settlement)
places.description: The principal ancient city on the Aegean island of Chios.

places.title: *Chondria
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 E5 *Chondria

places.title: Cyme
places.description: An ancient city of Aeolis.

places.title: Erythrai
places.description: Erythrai was one of the twelve Ionian cities of Asia Minor. It is located on a small peninsula that extends into the Bay of Erythrae.

places.title: Gargara
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 D2 Gargara

places.title: Gryneion
places.description: An ancient coastal city of Aeolis where an oracle of Apollo was located. It was located near the modern Turkish village of Yenişakran (İzmir Province) and the small cape known as Termaşalık Burnu.

places.title: Hephaistia
places.description: An ancient settlement on the northern coast of the Greek island of Lemnos.

places.title: Herakleia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 E4 Herakleia

places.title: Ilium/Troia
places.description: An ancient city of northwest Anatolia with occupation ranging from the Bronze Age to the Roman period. Troy features as the central setting of Homer's Iliad.

places.title: Kato Tritos
places.description: A modern village on the Aegean island of Lesbos. Remains of ancient houses have been noted in the area. Its modern name may preserve an ancient toponym preserved on a late-antique inscription. For these reasons, BAtlas followed Kontes 1978 in identifying it as the general area of a late antique sett

places.title: Klazomenai (earlier)
places.description: The initial, mainland site of the city, located to the southwest of modern Urla Iskelesi in Turkey. Pausanias reports that the city relocated to an island in the Bay of Smyrna, for which see "Klazomenai (later)."

places.title: Kokkinos
places.description: At Kokkinos (or Kótsinas) on Lemnos there is a mound-like promontory that projects into the Bay of Pourniá. Here was a once important Byzantine/Venetian castle that occupied the site of an earlier, Classical settlement.

places.title: Koloe
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 G5 Koloe

places.title: Lithi
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 B5 Lithi

places.title: Magnesia ad Sipylum
places.description: Magnesia ad Sipylum was an ancient city in Lydia in Asia Minor (modern Manisa in Turkey). Lucius Cornelius Scipio Asiaticus defeated Antiochus the Great at the battle of Magnesia in 190 BC.

places.title: Malene
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 D3 Malene

places.title: Marpessos
places.description: An ancient settlement in the Troad, located in the vicinity of modern Zerdalılık in the Turkish province of Canakkale.

places.title: Methymna
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 C3 Methymna

places.title: Metropolis
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 E5 Metropolis

places.title: Moria
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 D3 Moria

places.title: Mytilene
places.description: An ancient settlement. The early fortified core of the city was located on an islet off the east coast of Lesbos, now joined to the mainland. That site is dominated by the remains of a Byzantine fortress with Ottoman and Genoese repairs and additions. This original city later expanded onto the main

places.title: Ophryneion
places.description: Ophryneion was an ancient city of the northern Troad. It lay between Rhoteum and Dardanus. The site is located about 1.5 km north-east of the village of İntepe (previously known as Erenköy) in Çanakkale Province, Turkey.

places.title: Parakoila
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 C3 Parakoila

places.title: Pergamum
places.description: An important ancient settlement, located at modern Bergama in Turkey. It was first described in Xenophon's Anabasis and was later used as a treasury under Lysimachus. Pergamum became the administrative capital and principal city of the Attalid kingdom and dynasty (282-133 BCE) and was briefly the fi

places.title: Petra
places.description: An ancient coastal settlement on the island of Lesbos, situated around and atop a volcanic neck.

places.title: Philadelpheia
places.description: An ancient settlement of Asia Minor, modern Alaşehir, Turkey.

places.title: Phocaea
places.description: An ancient settlement of Asia Minor, modern Foça in Turkey.

places.title: Satala
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 G4 Satala

places.title: Sigeion
places.description: Sigeion was located in the northwest part of the Troad at the mouth of the Scamander river.

places.title: Skala ton Mistegnon
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 C3 Skala ton Mistegnon

places.title: Skepsis
places.description: An ancient settlement in the upper watershed of the Skamander (modern Karamenderes) river, located at and around the modern village of Kurşunlu in Turkey's Bayramiç (Çanakkale province). Significant archaeological remains, including a probable temple, on the dome-shaped hill immediately west of the

places.title: Smyrna/Eurydikeia
places.description: An ancient settlement of Asia Minor, modern Izmir in Turkey.

places.title: Temnos
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 E4 Temnos

places.title: Tenedos
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 C2 Tenedos

places.title: Teos
places.description: An ancient Ionian settlement of Asia Minor, located at modern Siğacik in Turkey.

places.title: Tisna/Titne
places.description: An ancient Aeolian city, Tisna was built on a pair of volcanic hills northwest of modern Uzunhansanlar (Aliağa, İzmir, Turkey).

places.title: Shiqmim
places.description: One of the largest Chalcolithic settlements in Israel located 1km east of Mizad Aluf in the northern Negev desert. The site was later occupied in the Byzantine period.

places.title: Acquapendente
places.description: The modern Acquapendente was settled in pre-Roman times but is known historically from the Middle Ages onward.

places.title: Priniatikos Pyrgos
places.description: Priniatikos Pyrgos is located on a limestone headland jutting out into the southwest corner of the Gulf of Mirabello in East Crete. Ongoing survey and excavation in the vicinity is producing evidence of occupation from at least the Late Neolithic down through the Late Roman and Byzantine periods. Wh

places.title: Saranta Ekklēsiai
places.description: A town in Eastern Thrace with signs of habitation dating from the Paleolithic period; it became a major city in European Turkey in the Ottoman period, and is now the capital of Kırklareli Province.

places.title: Saar Site
places.description: Early Dilmun settlement founded as early as 2300 BCE, with the main phase of the town being built around 1900 BCE. The site, which is located in modern Bahrain, continued in use around 100-200 years after the establishment of this main phase.

places.title: Aštamaku
places.description: A town mentioned in Neo-Assyrian sources that is identified with modern Tell Mastumah.

places.title: Deir Qeruh
places.description: Deir Qeruh is a Byzantine-period village located in the Golan Heights within the Israeli national park of the Gamla nature reserve. The village was founded in the fourth century CE, and a church and monastery followed in the sixth century. The village was abandoned following the Arab conquest.

places.title: Peshawar
places.description: Ancient Peshawar was a capital of the Gandharan kingdom from the second century AD, when it was known as Purushapura.

places.title: Abia
places.description: An ancient coastal city of Messenia that modern scholars locate in an area known in modern times as Palaiochora, i.e., in the modern village that now takes its name from the ancient one. Ruins of a medieval (Venetian?) castle are generally assumed to have been built on the ancient site.

places.title: Aigeira
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 C1 Aigeira

places.title: Aigiai
places.description: An ancient settlement in Lakonia, mentioned by Strabo and Pausanias. Since the early 20th century, scholars have connected it with Classical and Roman remains at a site consequently dubbed "Palaeochora" between modern Aigies/Aigiai (formerly Chania Koutoumous) and Limni.

places.title: Aristonautai
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 D1 Aristonautai

places.title: Asea
places.description: Asea was a town of Arcadia, located in the district Maenalia. Lying near the frontier of Laconia, Asea was to be found along the road from Megalopolis to Pallantium and Tegea. Asea participated in the foundation of Megalopolis and many of its inhabitants relocated there.

places.title: Asine
places.description: Asine was an ancient Greek city of Argolis.

places.title: Asopos
places.description: An ancient settlement located in a protected bay on the west coast of the Parnon peninsula (Peloponnese), now occupied by modern Plitra. The modern town that now carries the name "Asopos" lies some 5 kilometers north of ancient Asopos (modern Plitra).

places.title: Kastro ano Diakopto
places.description: Abundant spolia, artifacts, and building foundations provide evidence for an ancient settlement in the area of modern Kastro ano Diakopto and the church of Ag. Athanasios on the hill above it to the west. It is probably to be identified with ancient Boura, an attested settlement of Achaia.

places.title: Emborio
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 G4 Emborio

places.title: Epidauros
places.description: Epidauros is located on a small peninsula on the eastern coast of Peloponnesus.

places.title: Epidauros Limera
places.description: An ancient settlement on the east coast of Lakonia. The site, sometimes referred to today as Palaia Monemvasia, has produced evidence for habitation dating from at least the Late Helladic period to perhaps as late as the 6th century CE.

places.title: Geraistos
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 H2 Geraistos

places.title: Geronthrai
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 D4 Geronthrai

places.title: Gyth(e)ion
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 D4 Gyth(e)ion

places.title: Halieis
places.description: An ancient Greek harbor city in the Argolid (across from the modern village of Porto Cheli) that was abandoned toward the end of the fourth century BCE. Excavated remains include fortification walls (as early as the eighth century BCE), a city with an orthogonal street plan, an industrial quarter, a

places.title: Harpina
places.description: An ancient city of Elis, just east of Olympia, mentioned in ancient sources. It is thought to have been located at a site just north of modern Archaia Pisa (Miraka).

places.title: Helike
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 C1 Helike

places.title: Heraia
places.description: An ancient city of Arcadia, located on the north bank of the Alpheius river, east of its confluence with the Ladon. Archaeological evidence for its location has been identified near modern Hagios Ioannis.

places.title: Hermion(e)
places.description: Hermion(e) was a settlement of the eastern Argolid.

places.title: Hypsous (settlement)
places.description: An ancient settlement, ruined by Pausanias' day, thought to have been located in the vicinity of the modern village of Stemnitsa in Greece's Trikoloni municipality (Arcadia).

places.title: Hysiai
places.description: Hysiai was a frontier citadel of Argos located to the south of the modern village of Achladokampos. The Lacedaemonians destroyed the site in 417 B.C. Pausanias visited the ruined settlement, while Curtius described the remains of the fortifications.

places.title: Ioulis
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 G2 Ioulis

places.title: Isthmia
places.description: Isthmia was a major sanctuary located on the Isthmus of Corinth, which was sacred to Poseidon and Melikertes Palaimon, and site of the panhellenic Isthmian games.

places.title: Karthaia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 G2 Karthaia

places.title: Kastri
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 G2 Kastri

places.title: Kato Komia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 H4 Kato Komia

places.title: Kenchreai
places.description: The ancient Saronic Gulf port of Corinth (near modern Kechries in Greece).

places.title: Kleitor
places.description: An ancient city of Arcadia in the Peloponnese. The site of ancient Kleitor lies at the western end of a valley; modern Kleitoria lies at the eastern end.

places.title: Koresia/Arsinoe
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 G2 Koresia/Arsinoe

places.title: Kraneion
places.description: Pausanias describes the Kraneion as a grove of cypress trees located on the outskirts of Corinth.

places.title: Krokeai
places.description: Krokeai was a settlement in southern Laconia.

places.title: Krommyon
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 E2 Krommyon

places.title: Kythera (settlement)
places.description: An ancient settlement on the Aegean island of the same name. Its acropolis was probably at the site now known as Palaikastro.

places.title: Kythnos
places.description: The chief, homonymous city on the Cycladic island of Kythnos (modern Vriokastro/Episkopi).

places.title: Lechaion
places.description: The port of ancient Corinth.

places.title: Leontion
places.description: An ancient settlement of Achaea in the northern Pelopnnese, the site is located on a hillside known today as Kastritsi at the northern foot of mount Erymanthos. It is not to be confused with the modern settlement of Leontio, which is located about 10 km north.

places.title: Lepreon
places.description: An ancient city of Elis.

places.title: Loukou
places.description: A villa of Roman Imperial date, attributed to Herodes Atticus and his heirs. The modern name comes from the nearby Moni Loukous, or monastery of Loukou (St. Luke?), which may sit above an early Christian church.

places.title: Lousoi
places.description: A settlement in Azania, located near modern Kato Lusi, that has been under excavation since the late 19th century.

places.title: Lykosoura
places.description: A city of Arcadia and home of the cult of Despoina

places.title: Makistos
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 B2 Makistos

places.title: Mantineia/Antigoneia
places.description: Mantineia/Antigoneia was an ancient settlement in Greece most noted for being the site of two major battles. The First Battle of Mantineia was the largest land battle of the Peloponnesian War (418 B.C.) and the Second Battle of Mantineia brought an end to Theban hegemony (362 B.C.).

places.title: Megalopolis
places.description: An ancient settlement in Arcadia in the Peloponnese, likely founded in the 4th century BCE. The site lies just to the northeast of the modern town of Megalopolis.

places.title: Melos (settlement)
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 G4 Melos

places.title: Messene
places.description: Capital of Messenia

places.title: Methana/Arsinoe
places.description: Methana/Arsinoe refers to a peninsula and settlement located on the north coast of the Argolid. In geological terms, the peninsula is formed by relatively recent volcanic activity, with the last-known eruptive activity in the third century BCE. Human activity on the peninsula spans many periods. The

places.title: Methone/Mothone (Messenian)
places.description: An ancient settlement sited on the west coast of the Messenian peninsula of the Peloponnese. The collocated modern settlement is called Methoni and is located in the administratively part of the Pylos-Nestoras municipality, Messenia regional unit, of the modern Greek state.

places.title: Methydrion
places.description: An ancient city in northern Arcadia, located near the modern Greek town that now bears its name (formerly Nemnitsa).

places.title: Midea
places.description: An ancient site in the Argolid in Greece, it shares a name with the neighboring modern town.

places.title: Nauplia
places.description: Although the Classical/Hellenistic city was deserted in Pausanias' day, archaeology reveals that the area of modern Nafplio and its natural harbor on the Argolic Gulf was repeatedly a site of habitation and human activity from the Neolithic period to the modern day. Remains of a Hellenistic acropoli

places.title: Nestane
places.description: An ancient fortified settlement in Arcadia.

places.title: Orchomenos (Arcadia)
places.description: The so-called "Arcadian Orchomenos", located near a modern village in the Peloponnese that, until the 1960s, was known as Kalpaki.

places.title: Panormos (Megarid)
places.description: An ancient harbor and associated settlement on the Alkyonides Gulf at Psatha, attested in a fragmentary inscription.

places.title: Paos
places.description: An ancient settlement of Arcadia. The remains of its acropolis (Paleokastro) lie on the Skoupitsi hill near modern Neon Paos.

places.title: Patra(e)
places.description: Patra(e) (modern Patras) is an important ancient center with settlement beginning in the Late Helladic period. Patras played a leading role in the foundation of the second "Achaean League" and was the site of a Roman colony after 146 BC.

places.title: Pellana
places.description: An ancient settlement whose remnants are located at the modern village now bearing the ancient name (formerly Kalyvia Georgitsi) in Greece's Sparti municipality.

places.title: Pellene
places.description: Pellene was an ancient settlement in Achaea allied with Sparta during the Peloponnesian War.

places.title: Pherai
places.description: An Archaic period to Roman period settlement located near Kalamata, Messinia in the Peloponnese.

places.title: Phigaleia
places.description: Phigaleia was an ancient city in the southwestern part of Arcadia in Greece.

places.title: Poiessa
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 G2 Poiessa

places.title: Prasiai
places.description: An ancient settlement of Laconia, mentioned in a number of ancient sources. The site is located near modern Paralio Leonidi.

places.title: Pylos/Koryphasion
places.description: A Classical settlement, probably the Pylos of Thucydides, on the Koryphasion promontory, (modern Akr. Koryphasiou in Messenia) in the Peloponnese.

places.title: Pyrgoi/Pyrgos
places.description: An ancient settlement of Triphylia in the western Peloponnese, thought to have been located in the vicinity of the modern Greek village of Agios Elias in the municipality of Zacharo, some 36km south-southeast of the modern city of Pyrgos.

places.title: Pyrrichos
places.description: An ancient city of the Peloponnesian Mani, located near the modern village of Kavalos/Pyrrhikhos.

places.title: Sellasia
places.description: An ancient fortified settlement located a few kilometers north of ancient Sparta on a hill known in modern times as Palaiogoulas, which is east of the modern town of Sellasia. Sacked several times in antiquity, Pausanias reports the settlement was abandoned by his time.

places.title: Sicyon/Demetrias
places.description: Sicyon/Demetrias was an important ancient city of the Corinthiad, located some 26 km to the west of Corinth. The city had a long history, beginning in the Archaic period when Orthagorid tyrants ruled it. It flourished in later Archaic and Classical times, was a member of the Peloponnesian League, an

places.title: Sparta
places.description: Sparta was a prominent city-state (polis) of ancient Greece.

places.title: Tsitelbegebi
places.description: Settlement site between the villages of Takhtidziri and Dvani in the Kareli Municipality of Georgia. The site has late-Achaemenid-Early Hellenistic and Late Hellenistic-Early Roman period cemeteries. This settlement has largely been washed away by flooding of the River Prone.

places.title: Stymphalos
places.description: Stymphalos was a small but wealthy city of ancient Arcadia.

places.title: Tegea
places.description: Tegea was an ancient city of Arcadia. It is especially noted for its sanctuary dedicated to Athena Alea.

places.title: Theisoa
places.description: An ancient settlement of Arcadia. The archaeological site of the ancient acropolis is located at and around the thirteenth century Frankish castle, just south of modern Theisoa.

places.title: Thouria
places.description: Thouria is a settlement of the Peloponnese, with archaeological evidence ranging in date from the Bronze Age to the Roman period. The nature of the archaic and classical polity is debated in the sources. The ancient site is located in the vicinity of modern Aithaia/Hellenika, about 3 kilometers nort

places.title: Tiryns
places.description: A fortified Mycenaean center in the Argolid that flourished between 1400 and 1200 B.C.

places.title: Titane
places.description: An ancient settlement, long known to have been located near the modern town of Titani in Greece. It has been the subject of intensive archaeological excavation and survey only in the 21st century. The acropolis, of which significant fortification walls remain visible, is now occupied in part by the

places.title: Tyros
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 D3 Tyros

places.title: Zarax
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 E4 Zarax

places.title: Sikani
places.description: A town mentioned in Neo-Assyrian sources that is generally identified with Tell Fekheriye (Tell Faḫārīya).

places.title: Mandra Castellone
places.description: A fortified Oscan center at high altitude (647 meters) located near Capriati al Volturno. The site is difficult to access and the fortifications measure 80 meters in diameter.

places.title: Amiternum (Samnium)
places.description: An ancient city in Samnium located between Interamna Lirenas and Atina perhaps corresponding to the modern comune of Sant'Elia Fiumerapido (FR).

places.title: Ḥorbat 'Uẓa
places.description: Settlement east of Acre with remains from the Neolithic through the 12th century. The site was destroyed to make a highway in 1991.

places.title: Kalatepe
places.description: A Chalcolithic mound near the village of Büyükgülücek, 15 km. north of Alaca Höyük.

places.title: Tell Taya
places.description: Tell Taya is an archaeological site located in Iraq's Nineveh Province. The site was occupied from the third to the first millennia B.C.

places.title: Serra Orrios
places.description: An important nuragic complex that includes remains of a megalithic megaron-type structure.

places.title: Cortegana
places.description: A Spanish village located in the north of the province of Huelva that belonged to the kingdom of Alfonso X.

places.title: Aroche
places.description: A Spanish village located in the north of the province of Huelva, near Portugal, that belonged to the kingdom of Alfonso X.

places.title: Acharnai (N)
places.description: Acharnai (N) was the largest deme of ancient Attika, the sole inland deme of the tribe Oineis.

places.title: Agryle Hypenerthen
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B3 Agryle Hypenerthen

places.title: Aigina (settlement)
places.description: The primary ancient settlement on the Aegean island of the same name.

places.title: Aixone
places.description: Aixone was an ancient coastal deme of the phyle Kekropis, located on the west coast of Attica south of Athens in the area of modern Glyphada.

places.title: Alopeke
places.description: Alopeke was the only city deme of the tribe Antiochis in Attica

places.title: Amarynthos
places.description: An ancient coastal settlement on the island of Euboea, located at modern Palaiokhoria/Kato Vathia (just east of the modern Amarynthos).

places.title: Anagyrous
places.description: Anagyrous was a deme of ancient Attica.

places.title: Anaphlystos
places.description: A coastal deme of the tribe Antiochis in Attika, located on Anavyssos Bay.

places.title: Angele
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 C3 Angele

places.title: Aphidna
places.description: A large Attic deme, located on the Gulf of Kotroni.

places.title: Araphen
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 D2 Araphen

places.title: Artemis, T.
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 D3 Artemis, T.

places.title: Athmonon
places.description: Athmonon was an ancient inland deme of the tribe Kekropis in Attica, north-east of the city of Athens at modern Marousi, best known as location of a sanctuary and festival of Artemis Amarysia.

places.title: Aulis
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B1 Aulis

places.title: Besa
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 D4 Besa

places.title: Cholargos
places.description: Cholargos was an ancient city deme of the tribe Akamantis in Attica, whose exact location is debated

places.title: Daidalidai
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B3 Daidalidai

places.title: Eitea (Antiochis)
places.description: Eitea was an Attic deme of the tribe Antiochis, probably located at the site of modern-day Grammatiko.

places.title: Eleusis
places.description: Eleusis, located some 22 km west of Athens, was the site of the cult of Demeter and the sanctuary in which the Eleusinian Mysteries were celebrated from the Bronze Age to the Roman Imperial period. It was a coastal deme of the tribe Hippothoontis and site of a military garrison in the Classical and

places.title: Erchia
places.description: Erchia was an inland deme of the tribe Aigeis in Attica.

places.title: Eroiadai
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B2 Eroiadai

places.title: Euonymon
places.description: A classical deme of Attica, located at modern Trachones / Ano Kalamaki. The area has been continuously exploited or inhabited by humans since at least the Neolithic period.

places.title: Eupyridai
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B2 Eupyridai

places.title: Gargettos
places.description: Gargettos was an inland deme of the tribe Aigeis in Attica, probably located south of Mt Pentalikon in the area of modern Gerakas.

places.title: Halai Aixonides
places.description: Halai Aixonides was an Attic paralia deme of the Kekropis phyle. It was located near Cape Zoster on the western coast of Attica, south of the deme Aixones, from which the second part of its name derives.

places.title: Halai Araphenides
places.description: A coastal deme of the tribe Aigeis, in Attica, located on the eastern shore north of Brauron. The site was known in antiquity for its sanctuary dedicated to Artemis Tauropolos.

places.title: Halimous
places.description: Halimous was a city deme of the tribe Leontis, south of Athens at Cape Kolias, perhaps on the modern Hagia Anna hill.

places.title: Hermos
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B2 Hermos

places.title: Ikarion
places.description: An ancient settlement and inland deme of the tribe Aigeis, in Attica, said to be the birthplace of Thespis, the inventor of Greek drama.

places.title: Keiriadai
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B3 Keiriadai

places.title: Kephale
places.description: Kephale was a coastal deme of the tribe Akamantis in Attica.

places.title: Kephisia
places.description: Kephisia was an inland deme of the tribe Erechtheis in Attica

places.title: Kerameis
places.description: A deme of ancient Attica that was located in the center of Athens to the northeast of the Dipylon Gate.

places.title: Koile
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B3 Koile

places.title: Kolonai
places.description: An Attic deme, located on Mount Pentelicon near Hecale or Michaleza.

places.title: Kolonos
places.description: Kolonos was a deme assigned to the phyle Aegeis in Attica. It was located to the north of the Academy and provided the setting for one of the tragedies of Sophocles. The district is associated with the god Poseidon.

places.title: Konthyle
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 C3 Konthyle

places.title: Kopros
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B2 Kopros

places.title: Korydallos
places.description: An Attic asty deme of the Hippothontis phyle.

places.title: Kropidai
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B2 Kropidai

places.title: Kytherros
places.description: A deme of Attica located near Pousi Kaloyerou.

places.title: Lamptrai Paraloi/Lamptrai Hypenerthen
places.description: Lamptrai Paraloi ("coastal Lamptrai") or Lamptrai Hypenerthen ("Lower Lamptrai") was a coastal deme in the tribe of Erechtheis in Attica. The epithets distinguished it from neighbouring Lamptrai Kathyperthen ("Upper Lamptrai"), which was also in Erechtheis. For some purposes the two demes seem to ha

places.title: Leukonoion
places.description: Leukonoion was an Attic asty deme.

places.title: Mandra
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B2 Mandra

places.title: Marathon
places.description: Marathon was a coastal deme of the tribe Aiantis, in northeastern Attica, the site of the Battle of Marathon in 490 BC, and capital of the Marathon tetrapolis.

places.title: Myrrinous
places.description: Myrrhinous was a coastal deme of the tribe Pandionis in Atticia, located at modern Merenda

places.title: Oai
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 C3 Oai

places.title: Oinoe
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 A2 Oinoe

places.title: Oropos
places.description: Oropos was an ancient settlement and port located on the border between Boeotia and Attica; the bulk of its Hellenistic - Roman remains are thought to underlie the modern village of Skala Oropou. Oropos was source of ongoing disputes in antiquity. Colonists from Eretria founded Oropos.

places.title: Paiania Hypenerthen
places.description: A deme located to the east of Mt. Hymettus. The site is located on the eastern outskirts of modern Liopesi. The epithet "Lower" ("Hypenerthen") distinguished it from the small Upper Paiania, but the two formed a single entity for many purposes.

places.title: Peiraieus/Piraeus
places.description: The ancient, fortified port settlement of ancient Athens. It was also the coastal deme of the tribe Hippothoontis.

places.title: Pentele
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 C2 Pentele

places.title: Phaleron
places.description: Phalerum was a port of ancient Athens, located approximately 5 km southwest of the Acropolis of Athens, on the Saronic Gulf.

places.title: Phegaia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 C2 Phegaia

places.title: Phlya
places.description: Phlya was an inland deme of the tribe Kekropis until 224 BC and then of the tribe Ptolemais.

places.title: Phrearroi
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 C3 Phrearroi

places.title: Plotheia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 C2 Plotheia

places.title: Porthmos
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 D1 Porthmos

places.title: Potamos Deiradiotes
places.description: A settlement and deme of Attica, probably located in the river valley north of Thorikos.

places.title: Prasia
places.description: Prasia or Prasiai was a coastal deme of the tribe Pandionis, located in Attica, on the Koroni peninsula.

places.title: Probalinthos
places.description: An ancient deme of Athens in the plain of Marathon.

places.title: Prospalta
places.description: Prospalta was an Attic deme of the phyle Acamantis. Its location was in the interior, between Zoster and Potamus.

places.title: Salamis (settlement)
places.description: The ancient city of Salamis was located on the Saronic island of the same name, overlooking the modern Ampelaki Bay to the east. The site was likely largely in the area now covered by the modern city of Ambelaki/Ampelaki.

places.title: Steiria
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 D3 Steiria

places.title: Teithras
places.description: Teithras was an inland deme of Aigeis in Attica.

places.title: Thorikos
places.description: Thorikos was a coastal deme of the tribe Akamantis, in southeastern Attica. A significant Mycenaean prescence existed at the site during the Bronze Age.

places.title: Thria
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B2 Thria

places.title: Thymaitadai
places.description: Thymaitadai was a city deme of the tribe Hippothoontis in Attica, located in modern Keratsini, a western suburb of Piraeus.

places.title: Trikorynthos
places.description: Trikorynthos was an ancient deme of Attica.

places.title: Vouliagmeni
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 C3 Vouliagmeni

places.title: Xypete
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B3 Xypete

places.title: Worthy Down
places.description: A Middle Iron Age-3rd/4th century A.D. settlement complex at Worthy Down, lying 8 km. NNW of Winchester.

places.title: Kokino
places.description: Kokino is a Bronze Age archaeological site located in the Republic of Macedonia. The earliest occupational evidence belongs to the early second millennium BC.

places.title: Tell Ischali
places.description: Tell Ishchali is an archaeological site in Iraq's Diyala province. Its main floruit in antiquity was from ca. 2700–1800 BC, primarily Dynastic through the Isin–Larsa period. The site was part of the city-state of Eshnunna.

places.title: Boviolles
places.description: Gallo-Roman hilltop settlement

places.title: Kydathenaion
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 59 B3 Kydathenaion

places.title: Kollytos
places.description: An Attic asty deme belonging to the Aegeis phyle.

places.title: Sitagroi
places.description: Sitagroi is the location of an important archaeological site from the late Neolithic period and early Bronze Age.

places.title: Mons Faliscorum
places.description: Mons Faliscorum (modern Montefiascone) originally a Faliscan settlement, came later to be controlled by the Etruscans.

places.title: Oppidum du Castellan
places.description: A Gallic oppidum occupied from the sixth century B.C.

places.title: Poggibonsi
places.description: Poggibonsi is an ancient and medieval center in the province of Siena on the Elsa river. The city sits along the Via Francigena.

places.title: Ampelia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 F3 Ampelia

places.title: Kommos
places.description: The archaeological site of Kommos was a Bronze Age port and settlement in southern Crete with subsequent habitation and monumental construction dating to the Hellenistic and Roman periods. This site is possibly to be identified with Amyklaion, mentioned in contemporary sources.

places.title: Andros (settlement)
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 A4 Andros

places.title: Arkaseia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 E5 Arkaseia

places.title: Aulon/Alonion
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 C2 Aulon/Alonion

places.title: Brygindara
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 G3 Brygindara

places.title: Dreros
places.description: An ancient Greek settlement near modern Neapoli in the Lasithi region of Crete (about 15km northwest of Agios Nikolaos).

places.title: Eleutherna
places.description: Eleutherna was an ancient polis on Crete, some 25 km from Rethymno.

places.title: Eltynia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 D2 Eltynia

places.title: Elyros
places.description: An ancient polis in the mountainous Selino area of western Crete. Its site is located near modern Rodovani.

places.title: Gaurion
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 A4 Gaurion

places.title: Gortyn(a)
places.description: The Roman capital of Creta et Cyrenaica province, then Creta, and later seat of the Archbishop of Crete, Gortyna was a thriving community from the Geometric period to the Middle Byzantine period. The first traces of urban settlement date from the Archaic period. The ancient Greek law code known as t

places.title: Heraklion
places.description: Heraklion was the harbor city of ancient Knossos, and was later re-founded by the Arab conquerors.

places.title: Hierapytna
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 E2 Hierapytna

places.title: Hypsele
places.description: A fortified settlement of the geometric period, located at modern Ypsili on the island of Andros. Its ancient name is not known.

places.title: Ialysos
places.description: Ialysos was an ancient city located on the north coast of the island of Rhodes. Together with Lindus and Kamiros it was one of the three ancient cities of Rhodes.

places.title: Idaion Antron
places.description: A sacred cave on Crete where it was believed Rhea hid Zeus to protect him from Cronus. Archaeological evidence indicates use as a shelter or dwelling as early as the Late Neolithic period, with religious activities taking over in the Bronze Age and continuing through the Roman period.

places.title: Itanos
places.description: An ancient coastal settlement of east Crete. The site is located north of the palm forest at Vai and has provided evidence for occupation from the archaic period through late antiquity.

places.title: Ixia
places.description: An ancient settlement that Strabo places south of Lindos on east coast of the island of Rhodes. Nineteenth century scholars localized it at the ruined monastery of Ἁγία Ζωοδόχος Πηγή in Plimmiri, a decision followed in BAtlas. An extant church of the Zodikos Pigi is located near the modern mole and

places.title: Kamilari
places.description: An ancient settlement on the island of Crete whose ancient name is not known.

places.title: Kamiros
places.description: An ancient city of Rhodes, with evidence for Mycenaean occupation. From the eighth century BC a Greek settlement flourished, with a temple dedicated to the goddess Athena on its acropolis. The Hellenistic phase of the site followed the tenets of Hippodamian planning. The city was twice destroyed by

places.title: Karphi
places.description: An archaeological site in the Dikti Mountains of Crete that was the location of a post-Bronze Age 'refuge' settlement of Minoan and Mycenaean peoples.

places.title: Kasos (settlement)
places.description: The homonymous ancient settlement on the Dodecanese island of Kasos, which was located at modern Kastro/Poli.

places.title: Kastri
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 D2 Kastri

places.title: Katharo
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 E2 Katharo

places.title: Kavousi Kastro
places.description: An archaeological site (ancient name unknown) overlooking the Gulf of Mirabello in eastern Crete, not far from the modern town of Kavousi and the ancient site now known as Azoria (q.v.). BAtlas 60 E2 Kavousi (sic).

places.title: Knosos/Col. Iulia Nobilis Cnosos
places.description: A major ancient settlement of Crete located some 5 km southeast of Heraklion, Knossos was occupied from the Neolithic period to the time of the Roman empire.

places.title: Kretinia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 F3 Kretinia

places.title: Kydonia
places.description: An ancient settlement on Crete inhabited since the Neolithic period, Kydonia has been a major center of Minoan, Greek, and Byzantine civilization.

places.title: Kymisala
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 F3 Kymisala

places.title: *Ladarma
places.description: An ancient settlement on Rhodes, located in the vicinity of modern Laerma, and attested by epigraphic and burial finds.

places.title: Lasaia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 C3 Lasaia

places.title: Lato
places.description: Lato was an ancient city of Crete, a Dorian city-state located on Mirabello Bay. The principal ruins date to the fifth and fourth centuries B.C. and the city was destroyed ca. 200 B.C.

places.title: Lindos
places.description: Lindos is an ancient city located on the island of Rhodes.

places.title: Lissos
places.description: An ancient settlement and harbor on the southwest coast of the island of Crete at Ag. Kyrkos.

places.title: Lyktos
places.description: An ancient settlement on Crete, located just east of modern Xydas/Xidas, with which it is sometimes conflated. The city is mentioned in Homer and seems to have flourished in Hellenistic and Roman times, at least.

places.title: Mallia
places.description: Mallia is a site on the northern coast of Crete that was the location of a major Minoan palatial center of the Middle Bronze Age.

places.title: Matalon
places.description: An ancient settlement and port on the south coast of Crete, now identified at modern Matala. Excavations have revealed an acropolis, tombs, a maritime slipway for a shipshed, a quarry, and fish tanks.

places.title: Minoa (Pakheia Ammos)
places.description: This ancient settlement located on the Gulf of Mirabello at modern Pakheia Ammos in Lasithi, east Crete, has produced archaeological remains dating from Minoan times through the Greek and Roman periods.

places.title: Nopigeia
places.description: Remnants of an ancient settlement have been identified south and east of the modern beach village of Nopigeia on Crete that date to at least the 5th century BCE. places.title: Myrtos
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 E2 Myrtos

places.title: Phagai
places.description: An ancient people, tribe, or cultural group. Located: Tsambikas, on Rhodos.

places.title: Phaistos
places.description: An ancient settlement on Crete where occupation began ca. 3000 B.C., Phaistos was a major center of the Minoan civilization and continued to be a Greek city of the first millennium B.C.

places.title: Phalasarna
places.description: An ancient harbor town located on the northwest coast of Crete.

places.title: Phoinix
places.description: Phoinix was an ancient coastal city of western Crete that served as the port of inland Anopolis and also of later Aradena.

places.title: Trypitos
places.description: A small Hellenistic town excavated on the Trypitos promontory E of Siteia, Lasithi Crete. It is probably to be identified with Polichna, attested in ancient literary sources.

places.title: Pontoreia
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 G3 Pontoreia

places.title: Potidaion
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 E4 Potidaion

places.title: Rhodos (settlement)
places.description: A settlement on the island of Rhodes.

places.title: Rhonkchon
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 F3 Rhonkchon

places.title: Seriphos (settlement)
places.description: An ancient settlement on the island of Seriphos. Modern Seriphos town, also known as Chora.

places.title: Siphnos (settlement)
places.description: The principal ancient settlement on the Aegean island of Siphnos (modern Kastro). The locality has yielded substantial archaeological remains from prehistory to modern times.

places.title: Sybrita
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 60 C2 Sybrita

places.title: Tenos (settlement)
places.description: Ancient homonymous settlement on the Aegean island of Tenos (modern Tinos/Chora).

places.title: Vasiliki
places.description: A settlement in east Crete in use from the Early Minoan period to the Late Minoan period and again in Roman times.

places.title: Vigla

places.title: (W)Axos
places.description: An ancient settlement on the island of Crete.

places.title: Carn Euny
places.description: Carn Euny is an Iron Age site near near Sancreed in Cornwall.

places.title: West House at Vasiliki
places.description: The so-called West House is an architectural complex built as an annex to a larger building, the so-called Red House, in an Early Minoan settlement at Vasiliki on Crete.

places.title: Oued Beht
places.description: A large, prehistoric site in modern Morocco's Khémisset province that, at the time of systematic excavations published in 2024, constitutes the "earliest and largest agricultural complex in Africa beyond the Nile corridor". The site (which lies on a long ridge of high ground) gets its name from the

places.title: Chastel-sur-Murat
places.description: Site of an Iron Age oppidum.

places.title: Adisdara
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 6 D4 Adisdara

places.title: Ṣuwwānet eth-Thanīya
places.description: Settlement area 2.8km north of the center of modern Jericho with archaeological remains from the Early Roman period, Iron Age, and Late Chalcolithic. The site was at least partially destroyed by agriculture and construction of a road in the area.

places.title: Akra
places.description: A significant ancient settlement located in the modern Bannu district of Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. The site, comprising several settlement mounds, is divided by a stream known as the Lohra nullah.

places.title: Alexandria/Kapisa
places.description: "Alexandria in the Caucasus", an Achaemenid town re-established by Alexander the Great at modern Charikar, near Bagram in Afghanistan.

places.title: Alexandria Eschate
places.description: Located in central Asia, Alexandria Eschate (or "Alexandria the Farthest") was founded by Alexander the Great in August 329 B.C. The city was located in the Fergana Valley in what is now modern Tajikistan.

places.title: Arachosiorum Oppidum/Alexandria
places.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 6 B3 Arachosiorum Oppidum/Alexandria

places.title: Barygaza
places.description: Barygaza was an ancient port located on the Gulf of Cambay.

places.title: Bigis/Bestia Desolata/Parabeste

places.title: Kabul
places.description: Pre-modern settlement at and around the area of modern Kabul, Afghanistan has been known by various names in a variety of languages and periods. places.title: Cividade de Terroso
places.description: A settlement of the Castro culture founded ca. 900 BC.

places.title: Achladia
places.description: A Minoan site in eastern Crete that was the site of a so-called "large rural villa" covering some 270 square meters and dating to the Middle Minoan and Late Minoan periods.

places.title: Lithinos Pyrgos
places.description: Lithinos Pyrgos (now Tashkurgan, Xinjiang in China (塔什库尔干镇)) was a settlement located along the Silk Road. During the Han Dynasty the site was a major center of the Kingdom of Puli (蒲犁).

places.title: Marakanda
places.description: Marakanda (now Samarkand in Uzbekistan) was a major ancient settlement founded ca. 700 BC by the Sogdians. Alexander the Great conquered Marakanda during his eastern campaigns.

places.title: Akrotiri

places.title: Alabanda/Antiocheia Chrysaoron

places.title: Bargylia
places.description: An ancient city of Caria, now known in Turkish as Varvıl. The site is located near the modern Turkish village of Boğaziçi in Muğla province.

places.title: Cnidus
places.description: An ancient settlement located at Tekir on the western tip of the modern Datça peninsula in Turkey (ancient Knidia), which extends from the southwest corner of Asia Minor. In the later fourth century BCE, it grew markedly, succeeding the site at Burgaz as the political center of the peninsula.

places.title: Colophon/Colophon ad Mare/Notion
places.description: A port city founded by Aeolian settlers at the mouth of the River Avci.

places.title: Delos (settlement)
places.description: The ancient settlement of Delos, located on the Aegean island of the same name.

places.title: Europos/Euromos/Philippoi
places.description: Europos/Euromos/Philippoi was a settlement of interior Caria.

places.title: Halicarnassus/Halikarnassos

places.title: Heraclea ad Latmum/Pleistarcheia
places.description: A town of Caria located 25 km east of Miletos on the Ionian coast, Heraclea was located on the lower slopes of Mt. Latmos. Once a part of the Delian League, the city fell to Mausolos in the fourth century B.C. and his philhellene policy accounts for its change of name.

places.title: *Hydai/*Kydai
places.description: A ancient settlement in western Anatolia, ca. 8 km west of the modern town of Milas in the Muğla Province. Remains of the ancient settlement are located under and around the modern village of Damlıboğaz.

places.description: Magnesia ad Maeandrum was an ancient city on the Maeander River in Ionia, site of an important sanctuary of Artemis Leukophryene ("of the white eyebrow").

places.title: Palibothra
places.description: A key ancient city of north central India, Palibothra reached its cultural peak during the third century BC under Asoka.

places.description: An ancient Ionian port settlement in Caria, the site is located at modern Avşar Kale in Turkey. The site was abandoned in antiquity due to siltification from the Maeander river; it was modestly resettled in the Byzantine period.

places.title: Naxos (settlement)

places.title: Paros (settlement)
places.description: The homonymous polis and settlement on the Aegean island of Paros.

places.title: İstanbul

places.description: A small oasis lying about 60 km north west of Kharga, on the escarpment outlining the depression. places.title: Kellis
places.description: Roman/late antique settlement, with substantial remains of public religious buildings, including a large temple, residential areas, tombs, and three churches.

places.title: *Sioua
places.description: "Sioua" is the Greek reconstruction of an ancient toponym (found in Egyptian sources: S·t-wȝḥ) that encompassed some part of the western end of the Dakhla Oasis in Egypt (certainly the site now known as Deir al-Haggar was included, and possibly also Amheida).

places.title: Demircihöyük

places.title: Csopak

places.title: Tempa Cortaglia
places.description: An Archaic settlement in Lucania located near moderm Oliveto Lucano.

places.title: Unnamed settlement between Meğana and Makhamra, Algeria
places.description: Remains of an ancient settlement of Roman date, recorded by Gsell (AAA, whence BAtlas). The location should lie within 2 km of the BAtlas coordinates: a point west of the modern CW 24 highway between Megana and Makhamra in the Algerian wilaya of Bordj Bou Arreridj.

places.title: Motroninskoe Gorodishche
places.description: At Motroninskoe Gorodishche in Mielniki (central Ukraine, obl. Cherkassy) an early Iron Age fortified settlement has been identified. The ancient site was a large settlement of the ancient Scythians.

places.title: Archaeological Sites of Bat, Al-Khutm and Al-Ayn
places.description: Located in modern Oman, the protohistoric site of Bat and its neighbouring sites forms the most complete collection of settlements and necropoleis from the third millennium BC in the world.

places.title: Nuraghe Sant'Imbenia
places.description: A nuragic complex near Alghero, Sardinia, composed of a main, central tower flanked by two minor towers and a bastion, and surrounded by a village. The complex dates from the Middle Bronze Age onwards.

places.title: Apollonopolis Magna
places.description: The city of Apollonopolis Magna was located on the west bank of the Nile, south of Thebes. As the seat of Horus, Greeks regarded it as a site connected with Apollo. It served as the capital of the second nome of Upper Egypt.

places.title: Apollonopolis Parva/Diocletianopolis
places.description: The ancient settlement of Apollonopolis Parva/Diocletianopolis, modern Qus.

places.title: Berenice/Berenike
places.description: An ancient port city on the west coast of the Red Sea in modern Egypt, Berenice/Berenike was founded in 275 BCE by Ptolemy II Philadelphus, who named it after his mother, Berenice I of Egypt.

places.title: Coptos
places.description: An ancient settlement on the Nile river (modern Quft/Qift in Egypt) that flourished from pre-dynastic times through late antiquity.

places.title: Diospolis Magna/Thebai
places.description: Diospolis Magna/Thebai was known in ancient Egypt as Waset, "City of the Sceptre". The site was designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1979.

places.title: Eileithyiaspolis
places.description: Eileithyiaspolis is a city of Upper Egypt on the eastern bank of the Nile river. The site was occupied from the Neolithic period onwards. Its ancient name was most likely Nekheb.

places.title: Elephantine
places.description: A fortified settlement located just before the First Cataract of the Nile. During the Second Intermediate Period, Elephantine marked the southern border of Egypt.

places.title: Hermonthis
places.description: Modern Armant, an important town of the Egyptian Middle Kingdom that was enlarged during the Eighteenth Dynasty and continued to thrive through the Ptolemaic, Roman, and Coptic periods.

places.title: Nekhen/Hierakonpolis
places.description: The ritual and political capital of Upper Egypt at the end of the Predynastic period and the Early Dynastic Period, with occupation beginning as early as Naqada I. The site was an important ritual center for the worship of Horus.

places.title: Nuragic settlement, Antas
places.description: A Nuragic settlement that pre-dates and, in some cases, is re-occupied during the Roman period.

places.title: Liverdun

places.description: Larsa (modern Tell as-Senkereh), a city located ca. 21 km east of Uruk, was an important southern Mesopotamian cult center of the sun-god (Utu/Šamaš). places.description: Marad (modern Tell Wannat es-Sadum), a city located ca. 60 km southeast of Babylon, was the cult center of the god Lugal-Marda; it is approximately halfway between Babylon and Isin, on the Arahtu canal. places.description: A settlement in the Zagros Mountains, established in the 3rd or 2nd centuries BC and occupied through the Hellenistic, Parthian, and Sassanian periods. Archaeology has revealed a sanctuary of Herakles and possibly a temple of Athena.

places.description: A major Sumerian city-state founded during the Ubaid period, ca. 3800 B.C. In archaeological terms, Ur is particularly well known for the lavish tombs of its Royal Cemetery, its massive Ziggurat. The site served as the capital of the Ur III dynasty.

places.title: Uruk/Orchoe/Erech/Orikut
places.description: Uruk was an ancient Sumerian (and later Babylonian) city located on the Euphrates river. At its height (ca. 2900 BC), Uruk's population may have topped 50,000 people and its walls enclosed an area of more than six square kilometers, making it the largest city in the world at that point in time.

places.title: Zabala
places.description: This Sumerian/Babylonian city (also known as Zabalam, now as modern Tell Ibzeikh) was a cult centre of the goddess Inanna/Ishtar. It was located near the Iturungal and Ninagina canals.

places.title: Tepeköy Höyük

places.title: Ardashir-Khurra/Gur/[Firuzabad]
places.description: Ardashir-Khurra/Gur/[Firuzabad] was an ancient Persian city. Alexander of Macedonia destroyed the original settlement of Gōr, which was later revived by Ardashir I, founder of the Sassanid dynasty.

places.description: Pasargadae/Batrakatash was an ancient Persian city and the capital of Cyrus the Great (559–530 BC). It remained the capital until Cambyses II moved it to Susa. The site is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

places.title: Persepolis/Parsa/Persai/Sat Setun
places.description: Persepolis/Parsa/Persai/Sat Setun was the ceremonial capital of the Achaemenid Empire. The origins of the settlement belong to the sixth century BC (ca. 515). The archaeological site was named as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1979.
